tag: 週五收盤：那指大跌約 2.1%，標普 -1.09%
zh: 週五（10/16）美股全面收黑：道瓊下跌 175 點（-0.34%）收 52,002.41，標普 500 下跌 1.09% 收 7,659.44，那斯達克下跌約 2.1% 收 26,140.03。對照週四收盤，這組數字彼此吻合。整週來看，標普累計下跌 1.95%、那指下跌 4.48%，兩者都是 6 月以來最差的一週，道瓊反而週漲 0.67%。
en: On Friday (Oct. 16) the Dow fell 175 points (-0.34%) to 52,002.41, the S&P 500 lost 1.09% to 7,659.44 and the Nasdaq Composite dropped about 2.1% to 26,140.03. For the week the S&P fell 1.95% and the Nasdaq 4.48%, both the worst weeks since June, while the Dow still gained 0.67%.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，那指週跌 4.48%

tag: 晶片股再重挫：費半 ETF 單日 -4.14%
zh: 那斯達克的跌勢主要來自晶片股：iShares 半導體 ETF（SOXX）週五下跌 4.14%，本週的 AI 疑慮賣壓延續。標普 500 成分股中，Twilio 跌近 11% 居跌幅之首，Moderna、美超微、Datadog 與 Palo Alto 也名列跌幅榜前段，資料來源沒有交代各自的原因。賣壓集中在高估值的軟體與 AI 硬體，而不是整個市場同步下殺。
en: The Nasdaq's slide was led by chips: the iShares Semiconductor ETF fell 4.14% on Friday as the AI-monetisation worries of the week continued. Among S&P 500 decliners Twilio dropped nearly 11%, followed by Moderna, Super Micro, Datadog and Palo Alto. The sources did not give company-specific reasons, and the selling was concentrated in richly valued software and AI hardware.

Twilio，標普成分股跌幅榜之首，約 -11%
美超微，名列跌幅榜前段
Datadog，名列跌幅榜前段
Palo Alto，名列跌幅榜前段

tag: 油價仍高：WTI 約 97、布蘭特約 105，荷姆茲風險未散
zh: 原油週五小幅回檔但週線收漲：路透系報導盤中布蘭特約 105.45 美元（-0.44%）、WTI 約 97.35 美元（-0.63%），WTI 週漲約 5.9%、布蘭特週漲約 0.7%。支撐油價的是中東供給疑慮：一艘新加坡籍貨櫃船本週在荷姆茲海峽沉沒，報導稱遭伊朗飛彈擊中；另外美國商業原油庫存在 10/9 當週大減 860 萬桶至 4.156 億桶。各家對收盤結算價說法不一（有來源稱 WTI 站上 100），這裡採盤中數字。
en: Oil eased Friday but still headed for a weekly gain: Reuters-based reports had Brent near $105.45 (-0.44%) and WTI near $97.35 (-0.63%), with WTI up about 5.9% on the week and Brent about 0.7%. Support came from Middle East supply worries, including a container ship that sank in the Strait of Hormuz and was reportedly hit by an Iranian projectile, and an 8.6-million-barrel drop in US commercial crude stocks to 415.6 million barrels. Settlement figures differ across sources, so intraday levels are used here.

stocks.n: 原油 ETF，WTI 盤中約 97.35 美元
布蘭特原油 ETF，布蘭特盤中約 105.45 美元

tag: 一週結構：道瓊撐住、那指崩，是輪動不是普跌
zh: 把一週放在一起看會更清楚：道瓊週漲 0.67%，那斯達克週跌 4.48%，兩者相差超過 5 個百分點。週五標普成分股的漲幅榜上以能源與國防為主，包括 FANG、EOG、EQT、APA、RTX、諾斯洛普格魯曼，以及剛分拆上市的 Honeywell Aerospace。資金離開高估值科技、流向油氣與防禦性產業，是這週的主旋律。
en: Putting the week together: the Dow gained 0.67% while the Nasdaq lost 4.48%, a gap of more than five points. Friday's S&P 500 gainers were dominated by energy and defence names, including FANG, EOG, EQT, APA, RTX, Northrop Grumman and the newly spun-off Honeywell Aerospace. Money moved out of richly valued tech and into oil, gas and defensive sectors.

EOG Resources，油氣探勘生產，漲幅榜之列
RTX，國防與航太，漲幅榜之列

tag: Truist：每股盈餘 1.42 美元優於預期，營收被賣汽車貸款拉低
zh: Truist（TFC）第三季調整後每股盈餘 1.42 美元，高於預期的 1.14 美元；但營收只有 37.5 億美元，遠低於約 53 億美元的共識。落差主因是 9 月宣布退出近優質汽車貸款業務，出售約 55 億美元的 Regional Acceptance 貸款，以及可供出售證券的重新配置，非利息收入從上一季的 16.4 億美元降到 0.8 億美元。盤前股價約下跌 0.9%，市場反應相對克制；表面營收的大缺口要拆開看，主要是一次性項目。
en: Truist's Q3 adjusted EPS was $1.42 versus $1.14 expected, but revenue was $3.75bn against a consensus near $5.3bn. The gap reflects the September decision to exit near-prime auto lending by selling about $5.5bn of Regional Acceptance loans, plus securities repositioning; noninterest income fell to $0.08bn from $1.64bn in Q2. The stock was down roughly 0.9% premarket, a restrained reaction to what is largely a one-off item.

stocks.n: Truist，調整後每股盈餘 1.42 美元對預期 1.14，營收 37.5 億
區域銀行 ETF，同業財報風向球

tag: 嘉信理財：獲利略優於預期，營收小幅不及、股價回落
zh: 嘉信理財（SCHW）第三季調整後每股盈餘 1.69 美元，高於預期的 1.66 美元；營收 71.7 億美元，略低於預期的 71.9 億美元。淨利息收入較高支撐獲利，但營收小幅不及加上整體市場走弱，盤前一度下跌近 4%（約 92.96 美元，前收 96.80），事後報導稱當天跌幅約 3.8%。這是「優於預期卻被賣」的典型例子：預期已經墊高，任何缺口都被放大。
en: Schwab's Q3 adjusted EPS was $1.69 versus $1.66 expected, while revenue of $7.17bn came in marginally under the $7.19bn consensus. Higher net interest revenue supported earnings, but the small revenue miss in a weak tape sent the shares down almost 4% premarket to about $92.96 from $96.80, and later reports cited a decline near 3.8%. A classic case of beating expectations yet being sold because the bar was already high.

stocks.n: 嘉信理財，調整後每股盈餘 1.69 對預期 1.66，股價回落約 3.8%
金融類股 ETF，銀行財報季的整體指標

tag: 台積電：獲利與財測雙優於預期，但股價仍下跌 2%
zh: 台積電（TSM）第三季稅後淨利 7,631 億新台幣，優於預期；第四季營收指引 523 億至 543 億美元，中點 533 億美元，比第三季高約 14%。即使如此，台北股價 10/15 仍下跌 2.01% 收 2,440 元，亞洲晶片股當天同步重挫。這與 Ericsson 財報後一度大漲 11% 形成對比：同一週裡，「好財報」不保證股價上漲，市場要的是比 AI 預期更高的驚喜。
en: TSMC's Q3 net profit was NT$763.1bn, ahead of expectations, and its Q4 revenue guidance of $52.3bn-$54.3bn has a $53.3bn midpoint about 14% above Q3. Even so, Taipei shares fell 2.01% to NT$2,440 on Oct. 15 as Asian chip stocks sold off. Compare Ericsson, which jumped as much as 11% after its results: in the same week a good report did not guarantee a rally, because the market wanted a bigger surprise than AI expectations already assumed.

stocks.n: 台積電 ADR，Q4 營收指引中點 533 億美元，台北股價 -2.01%
Ericsson，財報後一度大漲 11%，對照台積電

tag: 9 月通膨偏熱：CPI 3.7%、生產者物價年增 6.3%
zh: 美國 9 月 CPI 年增 3.7%、月增 0.6%，高於預期的 3.6%；核心 CPI 年增 2.6%、月增 0.3%，同樣高於預期。緊接著公布的 9 月生產者物價年增 6.3%，是 2022 年以來最大漲幅，也高於預期的 5.3%。能源是主要推手，但數據顯示物價壓力相當廣泛；聯準會已在 9/16 升息一碼到 3.75%–4.00%，這份數據讓「是否繼續升息」成為 10/28 會議的核心問題。
en: September CPI rose 3.7% year over year (0.6% month over month), above the 3.6% forecast; core CPI rose 2.6% (0.3% m/m), also above expectations. September producer prices followed with a 6.3% annual gain, the largest since 2022 and above the 5.3% forecast. Energy was the main driver but pressures look broad; the Fed raised its range to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept. 16, making a further hike the central question for the Oct. 27-28 meeting.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，對升息預期最敏感
抗通膨債券 ETF，通膨偏熱的直接對照

tag: 華許不給暗示：10 月升息機率掉到約 15% 以下
zh: 聯準會主席華許（Warsh）週五談話沒有預告 10 月的決策，只說 10 月與 12 月都是決策點。市場解讀為偏向「按兵不動」：彭博報導 10 月升息機率從約 27% 降到 15% 以下，Polymarket 約 14%、維持不變約 87%。但 12 月升息的定價仍高，Polymarket 約 79%。換句話說，市場賭的是「延後」而不是「取消」。各來源對談話時間點說法略有不同，數字以報導時點為準。
en: Fed Chair Warsh on Friday gave no guidance on the October decision, calling both the October and December meetings decision points. Markets leaned towards a hold: Bloomberg reported October hike odds falling from about 27% to below 15%, with Polymarket near 14% for a hike and 87% for no change. December remains priced for a quarter-point hike at about 79%, so traders are betting on a delay rather than a cancellation.

stocks.n: 短天期美債 ETF，反映政策利率預期

tag: 官員口風：還會再升，但不急著 10 月動
zh: 多位聯準會官員在 CPI 之後表態：舊金山聯準銀行總裁戴利說後續很可能再升息，但 10 月沒有急迫性；副主席傑佛遜、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與理事沃勒都暗示可以先按下，沃勒更說升息不必在連續會議進行。9 月會議紀錄顯示多數官員預期年內還會再升一次，時點未定。長天期殖利率仍在高檔：十年期殖利率 10/7 盤中曾觸及 5.364%，是 2002 年以來最高。
en: After the CPI print, SF Fed's Daly said further hikes are likely but there is no urgency in October, while Vice Chair Jefferson, NY Fed's Williams and Governor Waller signalled the Fed could wait, with Waller noting hikes need not come at consecutive meetings. September minutes showed most officials expect another hike this year with timing open. The 10-year yield touched 5.364% on Oct. 7, the highest since 2002.

stocks.n: 七到十年期美債 ETF，十年期殖利率的直接代表
長天期美債 ETF，十年期高點 5.364% 的壓力來源

tag: 週線輪動：能源、必需消費、醫療領先，科技墊底
zh: 一份週度板塊整理顯示，到 10/14 為止的一週，能源上漲 6.7%、必需消費上漲 5.3%、醫療上漲 3.1%，科技下跌 5.4%，半導體更下跌 9.6%（不同整理的週期與數字略有差異，這裡取此份）。RBC 在 10/14 把醫療升到加碼、科技降到中立，理由是估值、資金流與半導體獲利預估的修正放緩。單日表現上，週四 XLK 約下跌 1.4%、醫療 XLV 約上漲 2.8%。
en: A weekly sector table for the week to Oct. 14 showed energy +6.7%, consumer staples +5.3%, health care +3.1%, technology -5.4% and semiconductors -9.6% (other tables differ slightly). On Oct. 14 RBC moved health care to overweight and cut tech to market weight, citing valuations, weaker fund flows and slowing semiconductor earnings revisions. On Thursday XLK fell about 1.4% while XLV rose about 2.8%.

stocks.n: 科技類股 ETF，週線墊底
醫療類股 ETF，RBC 升為加碼、週四約 +2.8%
必需消費 ETF，週線領先
能源類股 ETF，週漲約 6.7%

tag: 醫療股成為避風港：資金靠攏，但「確認輪動」還太早
zh: 週四醫療 XLV 約上漲 2.8%，同一天科技 XLK 下跌約 1.4%，加上 RBC 的升評，醫療被視為這輪科技賣壓的受益者。不過也有分析提醒，單一天的醫療漲幅不足以證明新趨勢已經成形；另有一份板塊報告指出醫療在其他統計週期裡是落後的。比較合理的讀法是：資金在找估值較低、對利率較不敏感的角落，而醫療只是其中之一，需要更多天的資料確認。
en: Health care (XLV) rose about 2.8% on Thursday while tech (XLK) fell about 1.4%, and RBC's upgrade has cast the sector as a beneficiary of the tech selloff. Some analysts caution that one day of gains does not confirm a new trend, and another sector report shows health care lagging over a different window. A fair reading is that money is hunting for cheaper, less rate-sensitive corners, and health care is only one of them.

stocks.n: 醫療類股 ETF，週四約 +2.8%
生技類股 ETF，醫療輪動的高彈性端
科技類股 ETF，週四約 -1.4%

tag: 能源與國防：地緣風險直接反映在漲幅榜
zh: 能源與國防是這週少數同步走強的族群：週五標普漲幅榜上有 FANG、EOG、EQT、APA 等油氣探勘生產股，以及 RTX 與諾斯洛普格魯曼。驅動力是荷姆茲海峽的航運風險、美國原油庫存大減與 WTI 週漲約 6%。風險在於這類走勢高度依賴地緣消息，一旦海峽風險緩解，油價與相關股票可能快速回吐；而且高油價同時是通膨的上游，會抵銷部分利率預期的緩和。
en: Energy and defence were among the few groups rising together: Friday's S&P gainers included E&P names such as FANG, EOG, EQT and APA, along with RTX and Northrop Grumman. The drivers were Strait of Hormuz shipping risk, a large US crude draw and a WTI weekly gain near 6%. The risk is that these moves hinge on geopolitical headlines and can reverse quickly, while high oil also feeds inflation.

航太與國防 ETF，國防股同步走強
EQT，天然氣生產商，漲幅榜之列
APA，油氣探勘生產，漲幅榜之列

tag: 羅素 2000 週五 -1.03%，已進入修正區
zh: 羅素 2000 週五下跌 1.03% 收 2,738.83（單一來源數字，與週四收盤 2,767.27 吻合），單週下跌 2.43%。它在 10/14 已較高點下跌超過 10%，是 3 月以來第一次技術性修正，彭博與 CNBC 都把原因歸於通膨、利率上升與資金回到大型科技的情緒轉變。週四它曾因輪動單日大漲 1.38%，週五就全數吐回，顯示小型股對利率消息的反應有多不穩定。
en: The Russell 2000 fell 1.03% on Friday to 2,738.83 (single-source figure, consistent with Thursday's 2,767.27 close) and 2.43% on the week. It had already dropped more than 10% from its peak on Oct. 14, its first technical correction since March, which Bloomberg and CNBC attributed to inflation, rising rates and a shift back to megacap tech. After Thursday's 1.38% rotation rally, Friday gave it back, showing how unstable small caps are to rate news.

stocks.n: 標普 600 小型股 ETF，對照 IWM 的品質較高小型股
區域銀行 ETF，小型股裡利率最敏感的一塊

tag: 判讀：為什麼小型股特別怕升息
zh: 小型股對利率偏敏感，主要有三個機制：一是許多公司借款以浮動利率計價，利率上升直接吃掉利息保障；二是中小企業再融資管道窄，到期債要用更高的利率換新；三是小型股的估值更仰賴遠期獲利，折現率上升時壓縮較大。這也是為什麼 CPI 一熱、升息預期一升，羅素 2000 就比標普 500 更容易走弱。反過來，當升息預期降溫（像華許談話後），小型股常常是反彈較快的一群，但持續性要靠獲利而不是利率。
en: Small caps are especially rate-sensitive for three reasons: many borrow at floating rates, so higher rates erode interest coverage directly; refinancing channels are narrower, so maturing debt rolls over at higher cost; and valuations lean more on distant earnings, which compress more when discount rates rise. That is why a hot CPI hits the Russell 2000 harder than the S&P 500, and why small caps often bounce fastest when hike odds cool, though durability depends on earnings rather than rates.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，利率敏感度的整體指標
標普 600 小型股 ETF，獲利門檻較高的小型股

tag: 背景：今年上半年小型股創史上最佳，這次修正從高位開始
zh: State Street 的研究指出，2026 年上半年小型股報酬 22.93%，大型股只有 9.55%，是小型股史上最強的上半年；2026 年的獲利成長預期也從第一季末的 15% 上修到第二季末的 20%。這解釋了為什麼這次下跌是從很高的位置開始：10 月的修正是「領先者回吐」，不是「落後者崩盤」。但同一份資料也代表預期墊得很高，只要利率或獲利稍有失望，拉回的力道就會比較大。
en: State Street research shows small caps returned 22.93% in the first half of 2026 against 9.55% for large caps, their best first half ever, and 2026 earnings growth expectations were revised from 15% at the end of Q1 to 20% at the end of Q2. That explains why October's correction starts from a high base: leaders are giving back gains rather than laggards collapsing. It also means expectations were elevated, so any disappointment on rates or earnings can bite harder.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，上半年 22.93% 對大型股 9.55%
羅素 2000 ETF（Vanguard），對照 IWM 的另一種工具

tag: 判讀：小型股的累積漲幅，與「曾經熄火」的紀錄
zh: Kiplinger 整理的數字顯示，自 2025 年 4 月以來，羅素 2000 累積報酬 48.1%，高過標普 500 的 35.6%；另有基金經理人引用分析師預期，認為 2026 年羅素 2000 公司獲利成長可達 54%。但同一篇文章也提醒，小型股的上漲過去多次熄火，持續性仍有爭議。把這些放在一起：修正前的漲幅與預期都很高，真正決定能否續航的是下一季獲利是否兌現，而不是單日的利率消息。
en: Kiplinger notes the Russell 2000 returned a cumulative 48.1% from April 2025, ahead of the S&P 500's 35.6%, and one fund manager cites analyst expectations of 54% annual earnings growth for Russell 2000 companies in 2026. The same piece warns that small-cap rallies have fizzled before and durability is debated. Put together: gains and expectations before the correction were large, and what decides whether the rally continues is whether next quarter's earnings deliver, not a single day's rate headline.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，同期累積約 35.6%

tag: Jewett Cameron：10% 大股東持續加碼，但公司還在虧損
zh: Jewett Cameron（JCTC）是美國西北部的庭園、寵物與圍籬產品供應商，流通股只有約 352 萬股。為什麼被忽視：市值極小、覆蓋少，近期財報連續虧損（9 月的報導提到單季每股虧損 0.23 美元、營收 985 萬美元）。什麼在改變：AJB Investment Fund II 的持股依 13D/A 從 10.9% 升到 12.54%，9/4 又以平均 2.92 美元買進，之前 6 月底到 7 月初買進價約 2.16–2.35 美元；公司同時清出過量雪松圍籬庫存、取消一份低毛利供貨合約。風險：虧損仍在、毛利下滑、受關稅成本壓力，大股東加碼也可能是想取得控制權而不是看好獲利。以上是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Jewett Cameron (JCTC) supplies garden, pet and fencing products from the US Pacific Northwest, with only about 3.52 million shares outstanding. Why neglected: tiny market value, thin coverage and continued losses (a September report cited a $0.23 per-share quarterly loss on $9.85m of revenue). What is changing: AJB Investment Fund II's 13D/A stake rose from 10.9% to 12.54% and it bought again on Sept. 4 at about $2.92, after buying near $2.16-$2.35 in June-July, while the company cleared excess cedar fencing inventory and cancelled a low-margin supply deal. Risks: losses, falling gross margin and tariff costs; the holder may be seeking influence rather than betting on earnings. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Jewett Cameron，10% 大股東持股升至約 12.5%，9/4 均價 2.92 美元

tag: Airgain：六季來首次年增，但現金只剩 760 萬美元
zh: Airgain（AIRG）設計無線天線與數據機模組，產品用在物聯網、車隊與消費性 Wi-Fi 設備。為什麼被忽視：小型、現金少、長期虧損，營收曾連續多季下滑。什麼在改變：第二季營收 1,370 萬美元，較上季成長 19%、年增 0.7%，是六季來第一次年增，調整後 EBITDA 約 40 萬美元；第三季營收指引 1,425–1,625 萬美元，中點高於第二季。風險：6/30 現金只有 760 萬美元，GAAP 仍虧損 170 萬美元，第三季毛利率指引 41.5%–44.5% 反而下調（記憶體缺料與 FCC 出貨延遲）；市場資料另提到董事買進，但未能從 EDGAR 驗證，這裡不採計。以上是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Airgain (AIRG) designs wireless antennas and modem modules for IoT, fleet and consumer Wi-Fi devices. Why neglected: small, thinly capitalised and long unprofitable, with several quarters of declining revenue. What is changing: Q2 revenue of $13.7m rose 19% sequentially and 0.7% year over year, the first annual growth in six quarters, with adjusted EBITDA near $0.4m; Q3 revenue guidance of $14.25-$16.25m has a midpoint above Q2. Risks: only $7.6m of cash at June 30, a $1.7m GAAP loss, and a lower Q3 gross margin guide (41.5%-44.5%) on memory constraints and FCC delays; a reported director purchase could not be verified on EDGAR and is excluded. A research lead, not investment advice.

tag: MSG 分拆：尼克隊與遊騎兵拆開，10/21 起可買賣預發行股
zh: MSG Sports 將把遊騎兵業務從尼克隊業務分拆：MSG Sports 更名為 MSG Knickerbockers（MSGK），新公司 MSG Rangers（MSGR）上市。登記日 10/20，每 2 股 MSG Sports 換 1 股 MSG Rangers；MSGR 預發行（when-issued）交易預計 10/21 開始，正式交易預計 10/27。為什麼值得研究：分拆案常因被動賣壓與缺乏覆蓋而被短期錯殺，是傳統的忽視來源。風險：交易仍需 Form 10 生效、聯盟最終批准與稅務意見；不同來源對日期與代號有小差異；兩家公司都由杜蘭（James Dolan）主導，治理結構是長期折價因素。以上是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: MSG Sports will spin the Rangers business off from the Knicks business: MSG Sports will be renamed MSG Knickerbockers (MSGK) and the new MSG Rangers (MSGR) will list. The record date is Oct. 20 with one MSGR share for every two MSG Sports shares; when-issued trading is expected from Oct. 21 and regular-way trading from Oct. 27. Why it matters: spin-offs often see forced selling and thin coverage, a classic source of neglect. Risks: Form 10 effectiveness, final league approval and a tax opinion are still required, sources differ on dates and tickers, and Dolan control keeps a governance discount. A research lead, not investment advice.

tag: Sonic Automotive：10% 大股東一週內再買 12,555 股
zh: Sonic Automotive（SAH）的 10% 以上持股人 Paul Rusnak 在公開市場連續買進：10/7 買 13,701 股（均價 59.78 美元、約 81.9 萬美元），10/14 又買 12,555 股（均價 59.90 美元），持股增至約 517.7 萬股。兩次價格都在 60 美元附近，沒有追價。要注意兩點：他是大股東而非一般高管，買進動機可能和經營決策無關；此外 SAH 第三季財報日期各來源不一（10/22 到 10/29），多數指向 10/29，投資人應以公司公告為準。
en: Paul Rusnak, a more-than-10% holder of Sonic Automotive (SAH), bought on the open market again: 13,701 shares on Oct. 7 at $59.78 (about $819k) and 12,555 shares on Oct. 14 at $59.90, lifting his holding to roughly 5.18 million shares. Both buys were near $60, with no chasing. Two cautions: he is a large holder rather than a typical executive, so motives may differ, and sources disagree on the Q3 date (Oct. 22 to Oct. 29, most pointing to Oct. 29), so rely on the company announcement.

tag: GameStop 執行長 10/2 買進 70 萬股，約 1,708 萬美元
zh: GameStop（GME）執行長在 10/2 買進 70 萬股 A 類普通股，Form 4 顯示交易金額約 1,708 萬美元（約每股 24.4 美元）。這是這週資料中金額最大的內部人公開市場買進。判讀時要記得：GameStop 是市值很大、關注度極高的公司，不符合「被忽視」的標準，這則放在內部人動向是因為金額規模，而不是因為它是冷門股。內部人買進只代表他願意用自己的錢押注，不保證股價上漲。
en: GameStop's CEO bought 700,000 Class A shares on Oct. 2, a Form 4 transaction valued at about $17.08m (roughly $24.4 a share), the largest open-market insider purchase in this week's data. GameStop is large and heavily followed, so it is not a neglected stock; it appears here for size, not obscurity. An insider purchase shows willingness to risk personal money, not that the shares will rise.

stocks.n: GameStop，執行長 10/2 買進 70 萬股、約 1,708 萬美元

tag: 判讀提醒：不是每張 Form 4 的「買進」都有訊號
zh: 追蹤內部人買進最常見的誤判，是把小額或計畫性的購買當成看多訊號。例如 German American Bancorp 一位董事這週買進的金額只有 100 美元，來自事先安排、用董事報酬自動買股的計畫；UMH Properties 一位董事買進 68 股、另一次約 1,987 美元，金額也很小。比較有參考價值的是：多位內部人在短時間內以公開市場價格買進、金額相對自身持股夠大、且不是股息再投資或員工持股計畫。一定要回到 EDGAR 的 Form 4 看交易代碼是否為 P（公開市場買進）。
en: The commonest mistake with insider buying is to treat tiny or scheduled purchases as bullish. A German American Bancorp director's buy this week was only $100 under a pre-arranged plan using director pay, and UMH Properties directors bought 68 shares and about $1,987 in separate small trades. More meaningful are several insiders buying within a short window at market prices, in size relative to their holdings, outside dividend reinvestment or employee plans. Check the EDGAR Form 4 transaction code is P (open-market purchase).

stocks.n: German American Bancorp，董事買進僅 100 美元、屬計畫性購買
UMH Properties，董事小額買進，屬累積型而非群集

tag: 判讀：政要交易追蹤器的數字為何對不上
zh: STOCK Act 的定期交易報告（PTR）給的是金額區間，而且可以延遲到 45 天才申報，所以它天生不是即時買賣訊號。這週兩個追蹤網站的統計就說明了這件事：一個說過去 30 天到 10/16 有 33 位議員揭露 819 筆交易，另一個到 10/14 只列出 283 筆，口徑和更新時間不同就會差出好幾倍。另外多數交易由配偶或信託帳戶執行，選擇權的履約價與到期日才是真正的資訊量，而跟單者實際買到的是別人 45 天前的價位。這個頻道只回答「誰申報了什麼、部位結構代表什麼假設」，不是買賣建議。
en: STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports give dollar ranges and can be filed up to 45 days late, so they are never a real-time signal. This week's trackers show the problem: one counted 819 trades by 33 members in the 30 days to Oct. 16, another listed only 283 as of Oct. 14, because definitions and update times differ. Many trades are executed by spouses or trusts, option strikes and expiries carry the real information, and a follower buys at prices set 45 days earlier. This channel only describes who filed what and what the structure implies, not advice.

tag: 一組有主題的申報：Paul Pelosi 的 Bloom Energy 與 Intel 部位
zh: 這組申報不是 10 月的新資料，而是近期市場討論最多、也最有主題的一份：眾議院 PTR 在 8/21 揭露 Paul Pelosi（配偶帳戶）7 月的交易，包括 15,000 股 Bloom Energy 與 200 口履約價 100 美元、2027 年 6 月到期的買權，以及 10,000 股 Intel（最高 100 萬美元）與 50 口履約價 50 美元、2027 年 6 月到期的買權。部位結構押的是「AI 用電需求加上政府對本土能源與晶片的支持」；Bloom 年初至今約上漲 107%，各媒體估計的總部位從 300 萬到 1,200 萬美元不等，因為申報只給金額區間。這只是在說明部位結構，不暗示任何不當交易，也不是買賣建議。
en: This is not new October data but the most discussed themed disclosure of recent weeks: a House PTR filed Aug. 21 showed Paul Pelosi's (spousal account) July trades, including 15,000 Bloom Energy shares and 200 calls struck at $100 expiring June 2027, plus 10,000 Intel shares (up to $1m) and 50 calls struck at $50 expiring June 2027. The structure bets on AI power demand plus government support for domestic energy and chips; Bloom was up about 107% year to date and media estimates of the total range from $3m to $12m because filings give only bands. This describes position structure only, implies no wrongdoing and is not advice.

tag: 今日評估：升息預期降溫了，為什麼股市還是大跌？
zh: 週五的矛盾很值得想：華許談話之後，10 月升息機率從約 27% 掉到 15% 以下，照理利率面是好消息，但標普仍下跌 1.09%、那指下跌約 2.1%。一個合理的解釋是，市場現在擔心的已經不只是利率，而是 AI 變現速度與高估值；利率降溫反而讓資金更自由地從科技流向油氣與防禦股。而油價高檔與荷姆茲風險又讓通膨的「底」遲遲不穩。如果輪動而非普跌是主軸，你手上的部位是在輪動的哪一邊？
en: Friday held a puzzle: after Warsh's remarks October hike odds fell from about 27% to below 15%, normally good news on rates, yet the S&P fell 1.09% and the Nasdaq about 2.1%. One reading is that the market's worry has moved beyond rates to AI monetisation and valuations, and cooler rate odds simply let money rotate more freely from tech into oil, gas and defensives, while high oil and Hormuz risk keep inflation's floor unstable. If rotation rather than a broad sell-off is the theme, which side of it are your holdings on?

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週五 -1.09%
那斯達克 100 ETF，週跌 4.48% 的科技代表
